Package hadur117.core.move

Class AimMembers

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.move.AimMembers
public final class AimMembers extends Object
MOVE-29 (K1 of the road to king, docs/bench/gun-oracle.md): the simple aims as members of the danger, beside the views. Three members, the head-on, linear and circular aims of SimpleAims one tick back, each put the surf's kernel on its angle, and the danger becomes the members' weighted mean with the views' score as member 0.

Each member keeps a rolling score of how well it predicted the bullets that hit us: a decaying mean (0.8 kept a bullet) of log2 of its probability at the bullet's angle over a uniform guess's, mixed with 0.05 of the uniform so a miss is not minus infinity. Its weight is its standing weight (1 for the views, 0.1 for an aim) times 2^(2.0 x score): a member counts for more once it has out-predicted the others on real bullets. Scores start at 0 and run across the rounds of a battle. The oracle's read on the 36 learning guns on flat movers: bullets from the safest third 8.1% to 7.6% (docs/bench/gun-oracle.md).

Pure: no engine types, no clock, no randomness. Duel only, off unless the duel turns it on.
